landmark_space_comment: world = MediaPipe's pose_world_landmarks (metric, hip-centered), fed into compute_angle() etc. as-is. normalized = MediaPipe's pose_landmarks (image-space, independently divided by frame width/height) -- the pre-this-change behavior, kept reachable for reproducibility. See results/diag_coords.md and results/diag_coords_C.md for why world was adopted as the default (it does not meet every pre-registered adoption-rule criterion either, but is the closer of the two to the mocap ground truth).
